766bc41dae22.title: DevOps Engineer (New Grad)
766bc41dae22.description_html:
We are looking for a passionate new grad to join our team as a DevOps Engineer. You will design and implement scalable systems. This is an exciting opportunity to work closely with our development teams to address their needs and scale out the infrastructure of our attribution pipeline and related technologies. You take ownership of our infrastructure over various locations and continuously scale it, making sure that our servers run smoothly and at their highest efficiency.   At Dream Games, all team members have a genuine chance to contribute to the final product and have an impact on the company. If you want to be a team member of a fast-growing company, you might be the person we are looking for!

Responsibilities

Building and supporting infrastructure and developer tools to improve game development processes Building advanced automated build, test, and release infrastructure Providing troubleshooting and timely resolution of the system, network, and infrastructure problems Identifying and solving critical problems and preventing them from reoccurring via root cause analysis and automation

Requirements

Fresh graduate from the university’s field of engineering Interest in cloud providers such as GCP and AWS Interest in Infrastructure as Code Knowledge of Containerized technologies and Container orchestration frameworks Passion and interest in games Appreciation and understanding of teamwork

Compensation & Benefits

Monthly net salary is 250.000 TL Health, dental, and vision insurance with %100 coverage Relocation support as needed   Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a top priority for Dream Games. We collect and process your personal data as confidential as part of the recruitment process. Please read our Statement of Personal Data Protection Law and Consent Letter to know more details.
